function.name: file_search
function.description: Search for files by name or pattern in a directory tree. Use this when the user asks to find files, locate code, or search their filesystem.

query.description: Filename or pattern to search for, e.g. main.cpp or *.gguf

path.description: Root directory to search from. Default is current directory.

examples.input: find all gguf files on my desktop
where is main.cpp in my project

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read the full contents of a file. Use when the user wants to see what is in a file, review code, or check a config.

filepath.description: Absolute or relative path to the file to read

examples.input: show me the contents of CMakeLists.txt

function.name: write_file
function.description: Write or overwrite content to a file. Use when the user wants to save something, create a new file, or update an existing one.

content.description: Content to write into the file

examples.input: save this note to notes.txt on my desktop

arguments.content: Meeting at 3pm. Check SimpleBLE path fix.

examples.input: create a hello world python script

function.name: shell_exec
function.description: Execute a shell command on the server machine and return the output. Use for system tasks, running scripts, checking processes, or any terminal operation.

examples.input: show me what processes are using port 8080
examples.result:
COMMAND   PID USER   FD   TYPE
llama-ser 1234 owner  6u  IPv4

examples.input: how much disk space do I have left

function.name: rc_control
function.description: Control the farm robot via serial connection. Send movement and arm commands to the Arduino/ESP32. Use for navigation, patrol, and physical deterrence.

angle.description: Servo arm angle 0 to 180 degrees for arm action. Default 90.

function.name: webcam_capture
function.description: Capture a JPEG frame from the IP Webcam and save it. Use when the user wants to see what the camera sees, take a photo, or capture evidence of an intrusion.

save_as.description: Filename to save the captured JPEG frame to

examples.input: take a photo with the farm camera
capture what the camera sees right now

function.name: generate_image
function.description: Generate an image from a text prompt using stable diffusion. Use when the user wants to create artwork, visualize something, or generate reference images.

prompt.description: Text description of the image to generate

output_path.description: File path to save the generated PNG image

steps.description: Number of diffusion steps. More steps = better quality but slower

examples.input: generate an image of a red fox in a forest

arguments.prompt: a red fox sitting in a dense forest, photorealistic
aerial view of a farm with security perimeter, diagram style

function.name: reflex_capture
function.description: Capture a camera frame and run the OpenCV DNN reflex detection layer. Automatically triggers fast robot responses for known threats (wild animals, intruders) and escalates unknown situations to VLM reasoning. Use for autonomous farm patrol.

save_as.description: Filename to save the captured frame

examples.input: check the farm camera for threats
examples.result:
Captured 49201 bytes to patrol_frame.jpg
[REFLEX FAST] deer (87%) -> Arduino:X
[REFLEX LOG] cow (92%)

Captured 51000 bytes to check.jpg
[REFLEX VLM] person (76%) -> VLM: Unknown person detected near east fence. Recommend alert.
